source_snapshot.procedure: Board easy to plug/unplug; device redetects without error after plug cycle.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/CRITICAL with full power isolation, ESD, retention and PCIe/HCA recovery.

old_problem: Board FRU/slot/topology, shutdown/discharge and retention procedure, seating criteria and PCIe/HCA/network recovery oracle were missing, but the source clearly asks for a physical remove/reinstall and redetection.
disposition_reason: Board removal never requires hot service in this row. ED-09 assigns it to a qualified operator and the conservative full shutdown/AC-removal/discharge boundary makes the method safe. FRU/slot/torque/link values remain mandatory runtime configuration under ED-03, not an unresolved review decision.
decision_basis: Direct XLSX rows 2269 and 2270, same-row AI fields, GPT V2, historical records and unique identity were reviewed.
Preserve CX7 board plug cycle, objective seating and error-free redetection.
Use workload drain, OS shutdown, AC removal and discharge before a qualified ESD operator disconnects cables/retention and performs one remove/reinstall cycle.
Bind board FRU/serial/firmware and PCIe slot/riser/root topology; photograph contacts, slot, bracket, latch/retention and final cable map.
After power restore verify exact FRU, PCIe generation/width, HCA/firmware, network ports/link and counter/log diff; enumeration alone is insufficient.
No power action, chassis/board handling, reboot or DUT query occurred.

test_case.test_name: Powered-down CX7 board remove/reinstall and topology recovery
test_case.purpose: Verify one exact CX7 board can be safely removed and mechanically reinstalled in its mapped slot and returns with full PCIe/HCA/network capability and no new errors.
required_package: Vendor shutdown/AC-removal/discharge and board service procedure
Retention/torque/contact/slot/bracket seating criteria and one cycle
Expected PCIe width/rate, HCA/network/link/counters and rollback
test_case.test_command: Drain workloads, capture baseline, shut down/remove AC/discharge; a qualified ESD operator photographs and removes/reinstalls the exact board once using the vendor latch/retention/torque sequence, reconnects mapped cables and completes inspection; restore power and collect full topology, HCA/network/link/error evidence.
test_case.expected_result: The correct board is fully seated/retained with undamaged contacts/slot/bracket and correct cables; after boot it has the approved FRU/firmware, PCIe generation/width, HCA/network identities and link state with no disallowed errors and stable final configuration.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires both physical service evidence and exact topology/function recovery. Missing runtime map/procedure blocks execution only. Damage, wrong slot/cable, degraded lanes, missing ports/link, new errors or failed boot/recovery is FAIL.
safety_gate: Qualified ESD operator with workload drain, shutdown, AC removal and verified discharge.
One cycle only; no hot removal or blind reseat.
Stop on resistance, damage, wrong topology or retention ambiguity.
Do not power on until cabling/retention/foreign-object inspection passes.
test_case.recovery: On damage or failed recovery, leave the platform safe, preserve evidence and use the approved spare/rollback teardown; do not immediately reseat again or power-cycle repeatedly.
